parsed.explanation: The write-up derives all finiteness from the "finite blocker" fact: a pairwise-intersecting family of finite sets has finitely many minimal finite transversals. That fact is false (ledger L6.2: F_k = {x_1,...,x_k, y_k} is pairwise intersecting yet has infinitely many minimal finite transversals), so its purported proof must fail, and the objection locates the failure correctly: after "inserting c" one is following a different branch, whose selected disjoint sets and pruning are not those of the original branch, so no contracted node on the original branch is produced. Nothing else in the text supplies the genuine number-theoretic large-prime erasure, which is the only route to finiteness here; no local edit repairs a false lemma.
